cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've sorted our breakfast budget. Taste this coffee substitute and then I'll fill my cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have proper coffee. I want that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're our quality check. If you say no, we keep the proper coffee. I'm not imposing anything that doesn't work for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want a croissant for doing your quality check.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A proper tasting breakfast, exactly. Choose the croissant; I'll pay. One sip before I fill my cup, and you decide whether my new budget needs revising.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 declares budget solved; A3 gives B veto and A5 pays for B chosen compensation while requiring B taste before A fills a cup.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 preference causes A3 conditional veto; B4 croissant demand causes A5 paid tasting plan.

relationship.evidence: B2 values proper coffee and B4 bargains for testing effort; A concedes materially to preserve participation.

heightening.evidence: A5 adds an expense to the budget-saving experiment but calls it a planned tasting breakfast.

specificity.evidence: A1 substitute and empty cup plus B2 proper coffee establish the test and alternative.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 budget revising phrase is explicit; the paid croissant supplies a concrete earned reversal.
